description: Stationnement vélos en région Centre Val de Loire is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by JVMALIN. This dataset meets the specifications of the “Cycling Stationing” scheme available on the website schema.data.gouv.fr Published on 2022-01-10. A column dedicated to the possibility of recharging your electric bike, not foreseen at this stage in the schema, has been added at the end of the dataset. Coverage: JVMALIN. The portal shows the English title as "Bicycle parking in the region Centre Val de Loire" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is JVMALIN. The listing shows 2 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2023-12-14 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
